title: Mont Blanc
description: Analogue photographs from around Mont Blanc by Bart Mulder: a mountain river, a pine forest and an aerial tramway, all shot on film.

images.alt: A scenic view of a flowing mountain river surrounded by evergreen trees and rocky banks, with mountains and blue sky in the background.
Aerial tramway car with open door, surrounded by trees and mountain scenery in the background.
A mountain river flowing through a dense pine forest with tall trees and rocky surroundings.
Mountain landscape with rocky slopes, dense green trees, a river, and partly cloudy sky.
